agendas.name: Scrap 'Em
agendas.description: Post-game: each ORKS unit that was in Engagement Range of an enemy VEHICLE or destroyed an enemy VEHICLE in melee gains 1XP. If a MEK unit gained XP, the force gains 2 Stompin' points.

agendas.name: Show 'Em How It's Done
agendas.description: Each time your Warlord destroys an enemy Character, Monster, or Vehicle, it gains 2XP (3XP if the Warlord is a Waaagh!boss).

agendas.name: Skrag Da Killiest Gitz
agendas.description: Pre-game: opponent selects their highest-points unit as Da Killiest Gitz. If brought Below Half-strength by an ORKS attack, the attacking unit gains 3XP. If destroyed, the destroying unit gains 3XP and the force gains 3 Stompin' points.

agendas.name: Overwhelming Aggression
agendas.description: Post-game: for each table quarter where you have more ORKS units wholly within than your opponent, select 1 unit there for 2XP. If you dominate all 4 quarters, gain +2 Stompin' points.
